How many slices of cheese did Carl use in total? Carl ate one sandwich every day for lunch during the week, using 2 slices of cheese on each sandwich. Carl ate cheese and egg omelets for breakfast on 3 days during the week, using one more slice of cheese per omelet than per sandwich. Carl made a big dish of macaroni and cheese to last several dinners during the week and used 8 slices of cheese in it.
